ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A hornless iron ox is an impossible case-animal that masters make charge, sleep, give birth to energy, and answer questions of succession.
EvidenceBody: Letan Hongying makes the hornless iron ox break a perilous iron barrier; Yandang Wenji places it sleeping at Shaoshi.
Yuanwu Keqin prays that it may always enjoy grass and water, while Baoning Chengtai answers a lineage question by saying it gives rise to spirited energy.
The witnesses retain one impossible animal image across different actions. None licenses reducing the ox to a single fixed equivalent.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: An iron monument-animal deprived of horns becomes an active case figure that can break barriers, sleep, feed, and declare lineage energy.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: Its actions vary by encounter; “hornless iron ox” is not a code that can be replaced everywhere by one abstract teaching.

DifferentThingTest.Reason: Both English orders denote the same iron animal deprived of horns.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The alternate supports searches that preserve Chinese modifier order.

ModifierControls.reason: 無角 modifies the iron ox as a whole and does not establish a separate hornlessness sense.
鐵 is retained visibly as ‘iron’ in the display target because the exact compound and all selected cases name an iron ox; it is not replaced by outside symbolism.

FamilyControls.reason: Horned oxen, generic iron oxen, and other impossible animals were excluded.
